svg.title: 2. Region failure, second by second
svg.text: new flows to us-west-2 in seconds
Ledger (MRSC): writes continue on us-west-2 + witness quorum. RPO 0.
conditional writes still protect the balance
Profiles (MREC): writable in us-west-2. The last ~1 s of east-only writes
replicate when east comes back; last writer wins
Aurora: back-office writes paused (writer was east)
reads OK from the local secondary
Losing us-east-1 at peak: what happens in the first 60 seconds (and the first 15 minutes)
5 s: 1st failed check. 10 s: 2nd failed check, targets unhealthy (ALB interval 5 s, threshold 2)
